model.label: Item model
model.description: Item keys around the model: GUI size, swap animation, model ids and the legacy model.

oversizedInGui.label: Oversized In GUI
oversizedInGui.description: Lets the model render beyond its inventory slot (from Minecraft 1.21.6). CraftEngine’s default is true.

handAnimationOnSwap.label: Hand Animation On Swap
handAnimationOnSwap.description: Whether the first-person swap animation plays when the held item changes. Default: true.

swapAnimationScale.label: Swap Animation Scale
swapAnimationScale.description: Speed of the swap animation; larger is faster. Default: 1.0.

itemModel.label: Item Model
itemModel.description: The items model definition the item points to (assets/<namespace>/items/<id>.json). CraftEngine sets it from the item ID by itself.
itemModel.hint: Only set it when another plugin or pack needs a fixed id; the item model tree on this tab is written to the item’s own definition.

customModelData.label: Custom Model Data
customModelData.description: A fixed CustomModelData number instead of the one CraftEngine allocates (for clients before 1.21.4 or other plugins).

legacyModel.label: Legacy Model
legacyModel.description: The model for clients before 1.21.4 with its overrides. CraftEngine converts the modern model by itself; use this only when that conversion is wrong.
legacyModel.hint: Not needed when the pack only targets 1.21.4 and newer.

generation.label: Generation
generation.help: Optional: parent, textures, display and gui_light of a model CraftEngine generates at this path.
